fact: The Council of Ministers discussed the Digital Transformation Ministry's draft cybersecurity, data and artificial intelligence, and digital transformation laws of 2026 and directed further study before approval by the joint session of the Council of Ministers and Sovereignty Council.
title: مجلس الوزراء يستعرض تقريري الوضع الاقتصادي الراهن والإمداد الكهربائي بالبلاد
